headline: On October 11, 1976: Washington promoted to General of the Armies
captionCards: Rank superior to any other US military title
Ensures no one can ever outrank the first president
instagramCaption:
George Washington received a unique posthumous promotion in 1976. 

The Founding Father was elevated to the grade of General of the Armies by an Act of Congress. This rank is superior to any other military title in US history. It ensures no one can ever outrank him. 

Washington led Patriot forces to victory in the Revolutionary War and served as the first president from 1789 to 1797. His legacy as the Father of His Country remains unmatched. 

Would you want this highest military honor?
